title: A more familiar Velora
changes: A quieter Mac-style interface, with system light and dark appearance and shorter, clearer labels.
Choose Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave Search, Ecosia, Yahoo, Startpage or Kagi, or add your own HTTPS search URL.
A What’s new window appears once after installing a new app version. You can reopen it in Settings.
An Open in default browser button for sites that need passkeys. Signing in there does not sign you into Velora.
note: Passkeys are still unavailable in this unsigned Mac build. Browser-wide passkey access requires Apple’s approved browser entitlement and signing.

title: More ways to organize your tabs
changes: Named workspaces, a command bar that finds tabs and bookmarks, Focus mode, and bookmark import from Chrome HTML exports.
